name: Corporate Action Event Processing Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of event processing.

GENL.name: General
GENL.definition: No debit or credit of resources.

DISN.name: Distribution
DISN.definition: Holder of the relevant security on a certain date, for example, the record date, will receive a benefit without giving up the underlying security.

REOR.name: Reorganisation
REOR.definition: Underlying security will be debited and may be replaced by another resource (or resources).
